Pricing questions

Frequently asked questions

Is there a setup fee?

PestFlow publishes no setup fee for its standard plans.

Can I change plans later?

PestFlow states that customers can change plans as their operation grows.

What happens after the 14-day trial?

PestFlow states that an unsubscribed account becomes view-only while data remains available when a plan is activated.

Is annual billing available?

Annual billing is available. Confirm the current annual amount and any active promotion before subscribing.

Do prices include SST?

No. Published prices are in MYR and exclusive of SST.
